hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: For each rectangle of dimensions [l, w], the square of its diagonal is l^2 + w^2 and its area is l * w.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Find the maximum diagonal square across all rectangles.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: In case of ties in diagonal length, choose the one with the maximum area.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass tracking maximum squared diagonal and tiebreaking area.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting the array takes O(n log n) when a linear scan suffices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use squared diagonal comparisons to avoid floating-point inaccuracies.
